audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1 and 2 disagree with the packet chart and with their own prose: row 0 reads Skill in both layers while whys[0] and early both say Akshan edges level 1; rows 1 and 2 read Vayne in both layers while whys[1] and whys[2] call them even/coin-flip.
audit.why: 48.51% over 872 games. Packet chart is Akshan / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Vayne / Vayne, which matches every line of prose on the page.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and win[0] = Akshan at 4/10; phases[1].side, win[1], phases[2].side, win[2] = Skill (ratings already 5/10). Rows 3-6 already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: "NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere" — sequencingCues is 0. Every phase why-text said "track Heroic Swing" without ever giving a number to track.
audit.why: Avengerang is 9/8/7/6/5s and Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s. Those two numbers are the whole lane: the window after either is spent is when Vayne walks up.
audit.corrected: Avengerang 9s at rank 1 stated in phases[2].why; Heroic Swing 18s at rank 1 stated in phases[3].why. Vayne's spikes are unchanged: Blade of the Ruined King first item, Final Hour 100/85/70s at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text claims "his burst can't kill you through Final Hour's healing". Final Hour grants bonus Attack Damage, invisibility during Tumble, a reduced Tumble cooldown and extra Night Hunter move speed — it has no healing at all.
audit.why: A player who believes their ultimate heals will hold a fight they should disengage. The real sustain in that window comes from Blade of the Ruined King's lifesteal, which is the item the whole page already builds toward.
audit.corrected: Replaced the phantom ult healing with Bork lifesteal. Also stated on the do-side that Silver Bolts stacks on attacks AND abilities, per Riot's wording, and that the third hit is percent-max-health true damage.

audit.why: packet suspectNames flags "Final Hour's" in spikes[3].text — FALSE POSITIVE, the matcher is tripping on the possessive. Final Hour is the correct Riot name for Vayne's R. The claim attached to it was wrong (see point 4) but the name was not.

edits.before: Kite with autos and never let him touch you. Identify how Akshan contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Avengerang outranges your auto both ways and his passive shield blunts your first trade — give up level 1 and last-hit safe.

edits.before: Q tumble resets make your spacing untouchable. Only take the trade when Akshan's Heroic Swing is down.
edits.after: Even from 2 — you are both auto-attackers, so whoever dodges Avengerang and lands cleaner autos takes the trade.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akshan must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Still a coin-flip at 3: Avengerang is 9s at rank 1, so step up the moment it is thrown and punish him while it flies back.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Heroic Swing's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Even through 4-5. Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 — the stretch right after he swings is the only window worth committing to.

edits.before: With 2+ items and Final Hour you outscale him hard; his burst can't kill you through Final Hour's healing and your true damage shreds his low-HP squishy frame.
edits.after: With 2+ items and Final Hour you outscale him hard; his burst can't kill you through Blade of the Ruined King's lifesteal and your true damage shreds his squishy frame.

edits.before: Akshan wastes Heroic Swing — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Silver Bolts stacks on autos and abilities — third hit is true.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His passive shield and extra shot win any melee exchange flat.

notes: Killed the fabricated 'Final Hour's healing' in spikes[3] — Vayne's R has no heal.
